# AI Widgets for Landbot

> Interactive UI inside a Landbot AI agent's messages (v4 web chat): the agent writes a tag, a Custom JS runtime validates it and draws a widget from verified data; widget buttons post as the visitor and write Landbot fields. Library `lbw-kit`. Widgets fill the chat column and lay out with container queries.

Start with [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/pausanchez/lbw-kit/blob/main/.github/AGENTS.md): the rules, the model and the short path in one file.

## Code
- [runtime/lbw.js](https://github.com/pausanchez/lbw-kit/blob/main/runtime/lbw.js), [runtime/lbw.css](https://github.com/pausanchez/lbw-kit/blob/main/runtime/lbw.css), [kit/kit.js](https://github.com/pausanchez/lbw-kit/blob/main/kit/kit.js), [kit/setup.js](https://github.com/pausanchez/lbw-kit/blob/main/kit/setup.js), [kit/kit.css](https://github.com/pausanchez/lbw-kit/blob/main/kit/kit.css)
- [kit/example/config.json](https://github.com/pausanchez/lbw-kit/blob/main/kit/example/config.json), [kit/example-lead/config.json](https://github.com/pausanchez/lbw-kit/blob/main/kit/example-lead/config.json): two bots' widgets as JSON
- [scripts/check-config.mjs](https://github.com/pausanchez/lbw-kit/blob/main/scripts/check-config.mjs), [scripts/bot-code.mjs](https://github.com/pausanchez/lbw-kit/blob/main/scripts/bot-code.mjs)
